text:
maya: Heads-up, onboarding perigee-13b to eval harness. Seeing weird metric drops on multilingual benchmarks after tokenizer switch.

samir: What switch? we pulled in the new sentencepiece config from model repo?

maya: Yeah — model repo had a custom spm with emoji normalization enabled. On en/ja/ar test sets emojis are being split into multiple tokens (e.g. "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦" -> 👨, \u200d, 👩, \u200d...). That blows up prefix-match and some n-gram metrics.

olga: Oof. Is this only eval harness, or also inference runtime?

maya: Repro in both, but CI/runner shows more pronounced regression because the eval collate step trims/rejoins prefixes differently.

pranav: Can you paste tokenizer output for a failing sample?

maya: Sure — sample: "家族👨‍👩‍👧‍👦と一緒に" -> tokenized: 
```
['▁家族', '👨', '\u200d', '👩', '\u200d', '👧', '\u200d', '👦', '▁と', '一緒', 'に']
```
Expect: ['▁家族', '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦', '▁と', '一緒', 'に']

jules: That's the ZWJ joiner gettting split because the spm was trained with NFKC normalization. The perigee tokenizer repo has a pre-normalize step. CI harness wasn't running that pre-step.

samir: So mismatch between tokenizer pipeline used during eval and the model's packaged tokenizer. Two fixes: 1) update eval harness to run model-provided normalizer, or 2) add a compatibility shim that re-joins ZWJ sequences before metrics. Which is cheaper?

olga: For short term, shim in eval harness to reconstruct emoji ZWJ sequences during collate. But long term we should canonicalize tokenizer configs in the model registry.

pranav: Agree. Also noticed some quantized runs (Q4F) on perigee show different tokenization when using fast vs python tokenizers inside quant runner image. Might be tied.

maya: CI failure detail: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234 failed on metrics stage. eval-bot posted: "metric diff: rougeL -7.2 for ja, -4.1 for ar". Logs show sample counts match but token-aligned references differ.

ci-bot: Build 1234 artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/perigee/1234/token-dumps.tar.gz

samir: I pulled token-dumps. There's a mix: some runs include the model's normalize_unicode() step, others not. The runner's docker image has python-tokenizers 0.11 vs harness expects 0.12 semantics.

jules: That's the CI wiring bug then — runner image pinned to old tokenizers. We'll need a tiny image bump and a smoke test that runs a quick tokenization parity check during preflight.

maya: Proposed action items:
- add emoji/ZWJ rejoin shim to eval collate (short-term)
- bump runner image to python-tokenizers 0.12 and add parity smoke test (mid-term)
- add a model-registry checksum for tokenizer pipeline and block onboard if missing (long-term)

olga: Who wants the PRs? I can do the shim and the smoke test harness. samir can handle the image bump and model-registry change?

samir: Yep, I'll do image bump + registry prototype. Will also add a CI gate: if parity smoke fails, auto-fail on-boarding.

pranav: Also add a note in quant experiments doc: QAT/INT8 runs must run the same normalization path as float baseline — otherwise metric deltas are meaningless.

maya: I'll open the ticket for re-running historical baselines after we fix tokenization parity (so product comparisons are apples-to-apples).

jules: One more gotcha — chat templates: some eval chat templates include emojis as separators in system prompts, causing weird prefix matches when tokenization changes. We'll scan templates and prefer ascii separators.

maya: Thanks. I'll start the shim PR and add examples to the failing CI artifact. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:

samir: tagging @pranav for the registry design review.

eval-bot: Note: scheduled eval re-run queued (job 789) once PRs merge.

ci-bot: Next build with image-bump will be triggered automatically on merged PR.
